news.summary: I finally went 100% wireless this year and you can get your desk looking equally fresh at a fraction of the co

content.v: I made the commitment this year: no cords on my desk. I already had a wireless mouse and keyboard so I got myself a controller charging stand (no more USB-C running to the top of my PC) and finally made the switch to wireless earbuds (no more 3.5mm cord to my speakers). I feel free at last! The only clutter left on my desk is... all my other clutter (not pictured). But no cords!

You can make the same commitment to a mostly clean desktop during Black Friday with some of the best deals on our highest rated wireless kit. I'll tell you what I've got in my real desk setup pictured above but I'm recommending some better products and better deals for you. I went back through my old order details and found out I spent a total of $354.93 on this setup (not including the Xbox controller itself) but you can get something similar for way less.
What I have: Nuphy Halo 96
You should get: one of these Keychron keyboards

I got myself a Nuphy wireless mechanical board a couple years ago because I wanted to dip my toes into hot-swappable switches and custom keycaps. I love it, but that's a bigger project than just getting yourself a decent wireless keyboard. To get the cordless life yourself, look instead to one of these Keychron wireless boards that our PCG hardware experts rate highly.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/qr4an2fctWBDyaKJXCHJJN-1920-80.jpg

K2 75% | Wireless: was $79.99 now $51.99 This is our favorite budget option on our list of the best wireless gaming keyboards . The Keychron K2 offers swathes of features that are more likely found on pricier boards, including both Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity and simple swapping between Windows and macOS.
Key specs: 75% | Wireless | Gateron switches
Price check: Newegg $114.01 View Deal
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/L4b797YrKNdJf2hcpTGfzA-1920-80.webp

K2 HE | Wireless: was $139.99 now $103.99 We're regularly endorsing the Keychron K2 HE, as we had for a very long time recommended it in our list of the best gaming keyboards. It may have been replaced very recently, but it's cheaper than the replacement right now. Plus, it's got the snazzy wood-like detailing.
Key specs: 75% | Hall effect | Gateron Magnetic switch
Price check: Amazon $111.99 (Black) | Newegg $149.99 View Deal
What I have: Razer Viper Ultimate wireless
You should get: Corsair Sabre

I tried and returned a couple different wireless mice recommended by my PCG colleagues and settled on the Viper Ultimate because it was just a smidge smaller than other favorites without being an actual mini mouse. I like mine! The Viper V4 Pro is in fact on our list of best wireless gaming mice , but the Corsair Sabre is there too and has a much bigger discount on an already lower price.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/4AaJcaYRutRHqs8C5qjfye-1920-80.png

Sabre V2 Pro | Wireless: was $99.99 now $49.99 Earning a 92% score from our Jacob Fox last year, this ultra-light gaming mouse is a bit of a beast. It's light, sturdy and comes with a great sensor too.
Key specs: 33K sensor | Wireless | 36 g weight | 8,000 Hz
Price check: Best Buy $49.99 (Black) | Walmart $127.66 (Black) View Deal
What I have: Jlab Jbuds Sport ANC4
You should get: An actual gaming headset

I cheaped out when I got a set of wireless earbuds because I wasn't sure I would like using them. I do, but stepping into a pair of the best wireless gaming earbuds that my coworkers actually recommend sounds so pricey. My Jlab pair is on sale, but you should get a real gaming headset at a real discount instead. Mine are for on-camera work calls but yours can be for late night Discord calls.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/XQXYXJLtgQ7ch76HQMogaM-1920-80.jpg

ROG Pelta | Wireless: was $129.99 now $64.99 50 mm titanium drivers deliver crisp sound, and the battery can offer up to 90 hours of power under the best conditions. Our James gave this set a very positive review , and he stands by their excellent sound and superb comfort to this day.
Key specs: 50 mm drivers | 20-20,000 Hz | Closed-back | Wireless | 70 hour battery life
Price check: Best Buy $64.99 (Black) | Walmart $79.99 (Black) | Newegg $79.99 (Black) View Deal
What I have: Razer Universal Quick Charging Stand for Xbox Series X & S
You should get: The same thing, but be wary of color choice

If you like using a gamepad on your PC like I do, I assume you already own your preferred brand. Assuming you have one of the 'big two,' I personally really like my Razer wireless charing stand. Alas, the white version for Xbox doesn't seem to be available anywhere so the only thing on sale is a bright blue one. Go for it, if that's on your mood board. news.title: 在爱上 GTA 6 中的 PS5 触觉反馈后，我开始关注 DualSense 控制器上的黑色星期五优惠
news.summary: Adaptive triggers are my new best friends.

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/u7wg9GREmrVN4Kr9AhrL4S-1920-80.jpg

DualSense Wireless Controller: was $74.99 now $54.00 Sony's standard DualSense controllers—the mainstay for controller for the PS5—don't have the hall effect sticks and triggers we might hope for, let alone TMR tech. But they do have Sony's proprietary adaptive trigger tech, which provide some delightful tactility in games that support it.
Key specs: Wireless and Wired | Adaptive triggers | Symmetrical
Price check: Amazon $54.00 | Newegg $54.99 View Deal

I spent years using a DualShock 4 for my controller-based PC gaming, back when it was more likely that you'd have to rely on community-made input mappers that would inevitably decide to arm wrestle with Steam Input for controller dominance. It eventually got to be enough of a headache that I bit the bullet, switching over to Xbox controllers and 8bitdo alternatives.

I've been borrowing a friend's PS5 for the launch of GTA 6, and after getting reacquainted with PlayStation controller hardware, I've been realizing how much I've been missing by not giving the DualSense its fair shake. Like our Morgan Park, I've been enamored with GTA 6's use of haptic feedback . I'm an adaptive trigger convert now, and thanks to Black Friday deals, I can grab a DualSense for $54 at Walmart and revel in the dynamic trigger technology I've been sorely missing.
It's time to go back to the old me. But like, a little newer. The newer old me. Do you know what I'm saying?

While it'll be nice to have a DualSense on hand for GTA 6's eventual PC launch—whenever that ends up being—I've been operating under the assumption that it's otherwise a bit of a wasteland in terms of adaptive trigger support on PC. Thanks to this handy list of games that support DualSense adaptive triggers from PCGamingWiki , however, that misconception has been dispelled. A lot of games I love are on here! I could've been enjoying Ace Combat 8 with the controller triggers doing things other than vibrating slightly! I've been a fool.
Better late than never, I guess. And better a $54 controller than a $75 one.

news.title: The Sony PlayStation DualSense Edge Controller Drops to $152 Exclusively at Lenovo for Black Friday
news.summary: Worth it for Grand Theft Auto 6.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/27/ps5dualsenseedgegta-1795807155102.jpg

Sony's official pro PlayStation DualSense Edge controller is much nicer than the standard DualSense controller, and a worthy upgrade for Grand Theft Auto VI, but it's pricey at its usual $200. The PlayStation Sale that went live earlier this weeked dropped the price to $170, but there's an even better deal today. Lenovo is currently offering it for just $152 with free shipping after you apply the 10% off coupon code " LENOVOBIGHOLIDAY ."
Black Friday Deal: 24% Off Sony PlayStation DualSense Edge

The DualSense Edge is Sony's official high-end controller for the PS5 console. It offers pro-level features like grips, adjustable analog sticks, mappable rear buttons, profiles, and more. They're very useful for those who are into esports or competitive online first person shooters and fighting games .

The sticks on the DualSense Edge are interchangeable; you can choose domed or convex replacements that come in two different heights. If your analog sticks crap out, you can replace them for $20 . The DualSense Edge comes standard with traditional potentiometer-based analog sticks, which can be more susceptible to drift, but some third party manufacturers now make aftermarket, drift-resistant TMR versions .

There are also two sets of interchangeable back buttons that can be mapped to any button on the DualSense Edge controller. For Grand Theft Auto VI, those buttons can be useful for switching weapons, sprinting or rolling in firefights, braking during car chases, or other actions that might normally force you to take your thumbs of the sticks.
Grand Theft Auto 6 is the biggest game release of 2026

GTA 6 is out and, not suprisingly, IGN's Luke Reilly gave it a 10/10 "Masterpiece" score . If you've been waiting thirteen years for this game to come out, it's probably worth splurging on a nice controller to play the game in all its glory, especially if it's on sale.

The triggers got special treatment as well. Next to each trigger is a stop slider that lets you adjust how far you have to press the trigger down to make it register. You can choose standard, medium, or short travel distances.
Accessories include a hard shell case and a nine-foot USB-C cable. It's a significant upgrade from the standard DualSense controller , made much better with this discount.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/05/29/marvel-super-heroes-play-booster-box-sale-amazon-best-deal-1780054155676.png
Magic’s busy year might have you wondering how in the multiverse, you can keep up with it all, but thankfully, Amazon has some handy Black Friday deals to help fill in the gaps in your collection.

Across its catalog, there are savings to be found on Booster Boxes from this year, as well as a product I’d highly recommend: The Starter Collection from Foundations. Here’s what’s on offer, and how much you can save.
Before We Begin

Sadly, the following are all Play Booster boxes. That means they’re ideal for building a collection without spending a ton of money, but they do have fewer chances at rare cards than the much pricier Collector Boosters. Plus, those are also harder to find.
The Best Amazon Magic: The Gathering Deals This Black Friday

Kicking us off is the oldest set of the Play Booster Boxes on offer, albeit not by much. Marvel’s Super Heroes was a huge step up from the Spider-Man set, and while your interest will naturally vary depending on how much you want the likes of Iron Man and Captain America cards in your Magic: The Gathering collection, we can’t argue with a good deal.

And, that’s exactly what Amazon is offering, with a $104.90 Play Booster Box down from $147.95 - at least according to Amazon. In reality, the box started off at $209.70, the standard MSRP for a Universes Beyond box.
That brings the price-per-pack from $6.99, all the way down to $3.50 - a 50% price cut.
Next up, The Hobbit brought us back to Middle-Earth after our (excellent) first time visiting with The Lord of the Rings set, and you can save big on a Booster Box.
Again, Amazon says it’s a 12% discount but that doesn’t take into account the MSRP of $209.70. So you’re actually saving a bunch more than that when paying $142.08 .
In terms of per-pack, you’re paying $4.74 for each, but this set has the added advantage of a Box Topper card.

Finally for Play Booster Boxes, Reality Fracture is discounted . It’s an awesome set (one that maybe deserved more chance to shine…) and includes Mirrorverse versions of classic Magic: The Gathering spells, characters, and creatures.
It’s now $125.08, reduced from $139.65, meaning each pack costs you $4.17.
One More Thing
Also reduced in the Black Friday sale is the Magic: The Gathering Foundations Starter Collection .
This is a box of more than 350 cards, including a bunch of staples for building your own decks, and is an ideal purchase for anyone new to the game who wants an instant collection.
It’s usually $59.99, but with a 25% saving, it’s down to $44.95 - and I can wholeheartedly recommend it.

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/NUgwBU6wSEh7ki2oDPt5R-1920-80.jpg

Timemore's reengineered S5 Pro flagship manual grinder promises an ideal brew through the power of unprecedented burr geometry. It's got a high capacity for a hand grinder, precision external grind adjustment, and a widened crank knob for easier grinding.
Key specs: 30g capacity | 48mm burrs | 15 micron adjustment steps
Chestnut S5 Pro price check: Timemore $179.00 View Deal

I'll be real with you: There are some days where my morning cup of coffee is the only thing maintaining my tenuous mental wellbeing. Sure, the caffeine offers some chemical assistance for weathering our era's daily whirlwind of psychic damage, but it's more about the ritual: The best way to start the day is by doing something nice for yourself, and there are few things nicer than a good cup of coffee. It makes games better, too. I wrote it on a videogame website and that means it's real.

I'm a pourover man myself, but whether you're using a drip machine, moka pot, or French press, nothing will improve the quality of your at-home coffeemaking like grinding your own coffee beans with a respectable grinder like the Timemore Chestnut S5 Pro , currently on sale at 20% off for $143 on Amazon.

There are two reasons why a good grinder makes for great coffee: First, coffee starts losing the volatile compounds that contribute to its flavor as soon as it's ground, so grinding your beans just before brewing ensures as many of those compounds are contributing to your cup as possible. Second, if your coffee grounds aren't a uniform size, they make an uneven brew: Inconsistently sized grounds—like those produced by cheaper, blade-based grinders that smash the beans apart—means your coffee can be simultaneously underextracted and overextracted, muddying the flavor with all sorts of undesirable notes.

A proper hand grinder gives you the best of all worlds: Fresh grounds on demand, quality conical burrs that produce more uniform grind sizes, and a cheaper price point than high-end grinders that might be five to ten times as expensive—or more. I'm in the market for a grinder upgrade myself, and that's why this Black Friday deal on the Timemore Chestnut S5 Pro caught my attention.

I've been happily using a cheaper Timemore grinder for a couple of years, so I can already vouch for the brand's quality. The S5 Pro brings some additional features that'd offer some quality-of-life upgrades over my trusty old C2: For one, it's got a bigger capacity. More interesting to me, though, is its precision external grind adjustment with numbered steps. My current grinder's adjustment dial is unlabeled, which can be irritating when I'm switching between coffees. That numbered grind adjustment will make it easier to dial in and keep track of coffee-specific grind sizes.

Timemore also boasts that the S5 Pro's reengineered burrs represent "a new benchmark in grinding." And if there's anything I love, it's progress. If that $143 price tag is too expensive of an ask for starting your coffee grinding journey, however, there are similar deals on Timemore's more affordable options: This $60 Chestnut C2S is a great entry point that'll give you a running start towards better coffee.
And as we all know, better coffee makes for better gaming. Probably. Do your own research.

news.title: Silksong 将在两周内免费扩展
news.summary: Sea of Sorrow looks rad.

content.v: In a "Cherry Time!" presentation , Hollow Knight developer Team Cherry has just revealed a first look at its much-anticipated first content update to Hollow Knight: Silksong. The nautical-themed Sea of Sorrow will come as a free update on December 11.

Team Cherry said that Sea of Sorrow will contain multiple new areas, power-ups, and bosses, while I clocked at least three new friendly NPCs in the trailer: A townsperson, a new shopkeeper, and a ferryman. Area-wise, I made out three distinct tilesets in the trailer: A rain-blasted fishing town on the water, a harrowing climb with an electrical storm element, and a green space reminiscent of the early game Bell Bottom.

At least the first of these areas appears to be built on cut content for Silksong: "Pharloom Bay" is well-documented on the Hollow Knight wiki , and would have been located on the east side of the map, near the thematically-similar Greymoor. Some elements in the trailer correspond to ones documented by the wiki, like an underwater submersible vehicle, or a scientific lab in the electrical storm area.

Which all sounds rad to me, particularly the submersible. Among the all-timer videogame level concepts, "underwater techbase" is one of my very favorites, and Team Cherry seem to be approaching these concepts with a Lovecrafty, Innsmouth flair that reminds me of the Fishing Village zone from Bloodborne.

Silksong is already a massive game, and I'm curious as to how Sea of Sorrow will fit both the map, and the game's overall flow from act to act. We'll find out for sure when the free expansion releases on December 11.

news.title: 30 款你需要玩的第一人称射击游戏杰作
news.summary: From the original corridor shooter pioneers to the incredibly sophisticated genre hybrids of the 2020s, these

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/27/fps-blog-1795779802336.jpg

Part of the promise of video games is putting yourself in another world, taking control of a character and experiencing adventure and excitement through their eyes. No genre takes this premise quite so literally as the first-person shooter, a pillar of the medium and a fundamental building block of the entire industry. There’s no shortage of shooters out there, but a select few stand above the rest as high-water marks for the art form. These are the 30 first-person shooter masterpieces you need to play
The Pioneers

Everything has to begin somewhere. For the first-person shooter, the primordial soup was a group of high school students working at a NASA study program in 1973. They created Maze War, a series of corridors you explored in hunt of another player to shoot. Unbeknownst to those students, they had triggered the start of an evolutionary chain that would lead to the creation of 100-player Warzone lobbies where victorious teenagers teabag the dead.

But the first of something is rarely the best, nor the most influential. And so we look a little further ahead in the timeline to find the real pioneers. Wolfenstein 3D , id Software’s 1992 classic, is undoubtedly one of them. But that Nazi-plagued labyrinth was quickly overshadowed a year later by our first true masterpiece.
Doom
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/17/30-fps-doom-1794930377152.jpg

If the FPS has a main character, it’s the marine that sits in the middle of Doom ’s HUD. A representation of not just your unseen protagonist but also your health, his chiselled features are progressively marred by blood and bruises as you push on through some of the most focused firefights the genre has ever had to offer. Free from the burden of storytelling and lore, Doom is all about the kill.

And there are so, so many kills. The garish corridors of Mars (and, later, Hell) are perfectly formed containers for exciting, kinetic, and challenging combat encounters. Back in 1993 we couldn’t even look up, but that didn’t stop id Software from assaulting us with an array of demons, both grounded and flying. Survival against such odds is made possible thanks to a small arsenal of weapons so purposeful in their design it makes modern shooters, with their army supply inventory, look like criminal waste – who needs (or even wants) 15 different SMGs when you can have the best shotgun in the business to gun down imps, and the chaingun with an RPM perfectly calibrated to interrupt a cacodemon’s fiery belches?
Duke Nukem: 3D
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/17/30-fps-duke-nukem-3d-1794930391823.jpg

The early days of first-person shooters were an abstract affair, with blank-slate protagonists gliding through spartan research facilities and gothic labyrinths. The setting was more of a suggestion to keep you moving, bleary brick textures on ray-casted walls for your mute hero to grunt against in search of secret doors. Gamers were more than happy with the arrangement until a potty-mouthed, stogie-chomping, mildly misogynistic meathead showed them a better way.

Apogee’s Duke Nukem 3D brought their EGA sidescrolling hero to a new dimension in the first hit shooter that dared to have a personality. Fully-voiced by Jon St. John, Duke oozed charisma, cracking jokes and one-liners appropriated from ‘80s action cinema. Fittingly, the first level sees Duke dropped onto an LA rooftop and fighting his way into an infested movie theater full of interactive objects, a far cry from the castles and space bases of his contemporaries. This was a first-person shooter that took place in our world, at our time, in places we could actually recognize, albeit with more burning barrels and floating powerups. The first-person POV was designed to help players embody their avatar, and Duke 3D was the first to make the world they inhabited just as immersive.
Unreal Tournament
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/17/30-fps-unreal-tournament-1794932566116.jpg

1999 is arguably the most important year in multiplayer history. Id Software continued to shape the bedrock of the entire FPS genre with Quake 3 Arena, an outstanding multiplayer hit whose engine would go on to power the behemoth that is Call of Duty. But just a few weeks earlier, Epic Games had shipped Unreal Tournament – the studio’s first dedicated PvP game, and the very first cog in the machine that would eventually become Fortnite.

But even 27 years and hundreds of innovators later, Unreal Tournament remains perfectly formed. It is a library of phenomenal level design, with the industrial ramps and slime pools of DM-Deck16 providing the perfect arrangement of height and hazard for the ultimate deathmatch, and the symmetrical halves of the incredibly lean Facing Worlds providing the blueprint for every great Capture the Flag map. The arsenal is fantastic (particularly the ricocheting pellets ejected by the Flak Canon) and the action a gore-soaked adrenaline rush, but it’s the precision-engineered maps that make Unreal Tournament an immortal classic.
Half-Life
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/17/30-fps-half-life-1794930410546.jpg

Valve does things differently. That’s a truth that goes right back to the developer’s very first game. Doom, Quake, and Unreal all have some kind of story wrapper, but they’re utilitarian – the gunplay is what drives them. Half-Life proved that narrative could be more than just a framework for FPS games. Gordon Freeman’s escape from a laboratory under siege is one of the richest stories a shooter has ever told, and it does it with barely any dialogue. Instead, the very walls and floors of the Black Mesa Research Facility provide the script – each new corridor and chamber the stage for a dramatic alien incursion or eerily quiet reveal. While Half-Life technically does have levels, the lab flows as one whole, continuous space, which cements it as a genuine place rather than a series of maps. The result is an experience that feels incredibly real, which only enhances the horror of your work colleagues being transformed into zombies.
Doom (2016)
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/17/30-fps-doom-2016-1794930542604.jpg

Doom has remained a titan of shooters because it never ages. It’s constantly being reinvented and updated, typically by modding fans who have created some of the original game’s greatest levels. But id Software itself has also approached its hellish masterpiece in brand new ways, and the exceptional 2016 reboot of Doom is gaming’s best example of how to revitalise a franchise.

The hyper-specific focus of the original game remains, but it’s elevated to impossible new heights by the punchiest gunplay you’ve ever pulled the trigger of. Your trusty shotgun rips demons apart, but when that’s not enough you can literally dig your hands in, tearing flesh to not just kill, but to replenish your own life force. This reboot arrived on the tail end of an era where shooters had been obsessed with cover and hunkering down to recover health. Doom said f*ck all that – to mend, you need to maul. And by tearing up the rule book, it restored the franchise’s HP to 100%.
Console Champions

So far, this could easily be mistaken for a list of the best PC games. When it comes to accuracy, the mouse is king, so of course many of the best shooters can be found on PC. But as soon as the analogue stick was invented, a whole new world was unlocked on consoles. While modern logic dictates that you need two sticks to make a shooter work, Nintendo has never been one for conventional thinking. The Nintendo 64 controller had just one analogue stick, and that carried us through one of the most seminal FPS games of all time…

news.title: 我试图在 GTA 6 中仅用一颗子弹获得六颗星，但却破坏了游戏
news.summary: We tried to get six stars in GTA 6 by firing just one bullet and broke the game.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/27/one-bullet-blog-1795788586117.jpg

If reaching a six-star wanted level in Grand Theft Auto 6 is your goal, there are many different methods available to you. Raiding the military base for a tank is one way. Committing a horrifying beach massacre is another. But can you get there by firing just a single bullet? We at IGN had a theory that this was absolutely possible, and so spent hours in a fast food joint to find out.

When we say “by firing a single bullet,” we mean that technically speaking. Our theory is that your chosen character only needs to pull the trigger once. That’s because, when roaming around GTA 6’s open world and causing whatever brand of chaos you’ve chosen to, your partner will automatically take up the fight against aggressors, and is both invulnerable and stocked with unlimited ammunition. That means if you decide to walk into a heavily populated area as a couple and fire just one bullet into the crowd, your better half can commit the lion's share of the atrocities themselves, provided you just stay alive.

We tested this out for ourselves, leading Jason and Lucia to the Taco Bomb in Gellhorn as our chosen arena of violence. Taking control of Jason, one bullet was fired into a poor staff member taking a break outside. Bits of brain now covered the forecourt, which somehow still looked like a more appetising alternative to whatever the questionable-looking beef was they were offering inside. Creeping cannibalistic thoughts pushed to one side, we walked back inside knowing our work was done. This public execution, perhaps rightfully, attracted a police patrol car to the restaurant, of which Lucia did not take kindly to their arrival.

Her love for Jason knows no bounds, up to and including unloading full machine gun magazines into any cops who want to arrest him. And who were we to stand in her way? Letting her take control of the situation was then required, honorably moving Jason behind the indestructible cover of an industrial refrigerator. Sporting an armoured vest just in case any stray bullets or shrapnel found their way around the corner, it was then time to hunker down in the kitchen beside that thick metal fridge, out of view of law enforcement. Crucially, this fast food establishment’s kitchen does not have a door leading outside, meaning the threat of flanking cops was neutralised. Luckily, they didn’t seem to spot the drive-thru window, which would’ve handed them a clean shot.

And there we sat for a good 45 minutes as Lucia angrily gunned down anyone brave enough to step into the restaurant. No more food would be served today, only death. The red of discarded hot sauce packets replaced by the blood of the fallen. The crunch of hard shell tacos drowned out by the crack of broken bones. All in the name of science. Could a six-star wanted level be achieved by us, the player, firing just one bullet?

Well, not this time. We could’ve sat here forever, bravely hiding behind a fridge while our partner slaughtered hundreds. Lucia was invincible, rounds of ammunition sinking into her skin to no effect. She had no shortage of ammo herself; with an unlimited pool of lead to reload from, she could’ve done this all day, and all for us. If that isn’t true romance, I don’t know what is. Day turned to night, and the restaurant workers diligently remained kneeling behind the counter and cowering for the whole sordid ordeal.

The problem is, our aggressors just… stopped. After a period of quiet, we chose to break cover and wander outside, only to be met by several non-aggravated members of law enforcement staring blankly at us. We had seemingly confused them with our methods of madness.

Because we’re so dedicated to the cause here at IGN, we tried all over again. Putting this first attempt down as an unfortunate glitch, we reloaded a save, made our way to Taco Bomb, and fired a single gunshot into our chosen test subject. And so, another hour of hiding behind a fridge commenced while our incredibly committed girlfriend peppered anyone who dared approach us with bullets. Armoured trucks eventually surrounded the exits, and the sound of helicopter blades could be heard above. But the same thing happened again. We even waited long enough for the rest mode settings on our PS5 to almost put the console to sleep.

It seems GTA 6 gets very confused if you decide to start a chain reaction like this, only to go passive for the next 60 minutes. Again, five stars were secured on the wanted level, but that sixth just wouldn’t arrive. The enemy AI’s brain could not comprehend what was happening, so we decided we simply had to intervene. If that sixth star was going to be ours, we’d need to get involved ourselves.

Thus, we thought we’d honor the place we’d called home for the past couple of hours, and end our occupancy of Taco Bomb with an explosion. A bunch of incapacitated, but not dead, cops lay writhing on the floor of the restaurant. Could just one grenade be our key to maxing out the wanted level? There was only one way of finding out. We ended the whole bloody affair with a bang, ripping the pin out of the explosive before hurling it into the mound of bodies. And that’s when it happened. Nirvana. The gates of heaven opened. Six-star paradise was ours to bask in.

So, what was the point of all of this? Well, more than anything, to confirm that you never have to worry about Jason or Lucia dying when roaming around GTA 6’s open world when not controlling them. Unlike in missions, where they can slip off this mortal coil, they can’t die in free-roam, and so you are clear to use them as superpowered distractions or unkillable meat shields if you wish. You don’t have to be as cowardly as we were, but if you have an hour free to watch an action movie scene play out while peeking out from behind the corner of a refrigerator, then that option is available to you.

There are certainly quicker ways to reach GTA 6’s highest wanted level of six stars, which means you’ll be hunted down until you’re dead, but this is one of the safest and requires minimal munitions from your own stockpile. Early on, we opted for the plane crash onto a beach, before mowing down all of the vacationers in a truck method, but since then, millions of players have been finding their own road to infamy.
But, in case you ever needed to know. Yes, it is possible to get six stars in GTA 6 with just a single bullet and grenade. As for just the single bullet itself… well, we’ll keep on trying.
What have been your wildest six-star stories? Let us know in the comments!

news.title: 空洞骑士：丝绸之歌 - 悲伤之海发布预告片最终确定发布日期，挑逗钓鱼
news.summary: Team Cherry's latest showcase gives us a release date for Sea of Sorrow, the free DLC expansion coming to Holl

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/27/screenshot-2026-11-27-153357-1795793658837.png
Team Cherry has just wrapped up its Cherry Time! showcase, giving us some long-awaited news on the future of Hollow Knight: Silksong.

The big takeaway here is that Hollow Knight: Silksong's first big expansion, Sea of Sorrow, finally has a release date of December 11. Sea of Sorrow will be available to all Silksong players for free. All you need is a copy of the base game, and you can start playing Sea of Sorrow when it goes live on December 11.

This also means Team Cherry has stuck to its promise to get Sea of Sorrow out by the end of the year. Some had feared that today's announcement would be a delay — or an announcement that the DLC was being expanded into a full game, which is famously how Silksong's development began.

In the showcase, we got a new look at Sea of Sorrow's gameplay. This gives us a good preview of what's in store for us, as we see new areas, enemies, and boss fights. Of course, it all looks as challenging as ever, as you'd expect for Silksong's post-launch DLC. And is that a fishing mini-game teased at the end?

We weren't told anything else about the future of Silksong or the Hollow Knight series at large. There was no mention of this being Silksong's only expansion, so it's very possible that Team Cherry plans to support the game beyond Sea of Sorrow.
For now, here's the official blurb on Sea of Sorrow:

Outside of this reveal, Team Cherry used the attention to promote indie games from other studios. Three were shown off: Blokkan: Secret of the Walking City, which is fully hand-drawn; Radio Rain, which is centred around 1980s-inspired music; and The Botanist and the Translator, which boasts a Sailor Moon-esque vibe.

In a follow-up blog post , Team Cherry confirmed that these new games will release under the new Team Cherry Presents label, which is headed up by the indie developer's fourth team member, Huy Le. Huy is technical director and on-going support for all the Team Cherry Presents games, but has also helped out on Silksong and Sea of Sorrow. "As a long-time team of three people, adding a fourth member is a big deal!" Team Cherry said.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/16/ghost-of-yotei-deal-1794842279840.jpg

And, if you've missed out so far on the follow up to Ghost of Tsushima, there's a whopping 50% discount on Ghost of Yōtei .
Save 50% on Ghost of Yotei In PlayStation’s Black Friday Sale

Back when it was released, he gave the game an 8/10 and said that it features a "predictable but well-executed story" that "takes you through Ghost of Yotei's gorgeous landscapes and satisfying, fluid action combat." I managed to play through it earlier this year as well and certainly agree with Michael's thoughts here. If you enjoyed Tsushima, you're sure to have a blast running around in Yōtei, and the combat may actually be even better than its predecessor.
It's not just Atsu's adventure seeing discounts in PlayStation's Black Friday sale, either.
2026 launches like Marvel's Wolverine has dropped to $50 as part of the sale, and Saros has also seen a big drop - ideal for anyone looking for a spiritual successor to Returnal.

There's also a solid selection of PS5 exclusives on sale for $30 or less right now, including big, beloved titles like God of War Ragnarok, Stellar Blade, and even Ghost of Tsushima (if you want to play Yōtei's predecessor).

news.title: 最重要的是，GTA 6 是一款坚固的隐形沙盒
news.summary: I came to GTA 6 for its wild car chases and explosive shootouts, but its the really solid stealth that has me

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/26/gta-6-lucia-stealth-1795690930066.jpg

This is an opinion piece from writer Samuel Horti. IGN's opinion columns represent the personal viewpoints of the writer, drawing on their own experiences and research to explore the exciting world of video games.

Grand Theft Auto is a boisterous, brash series full of loud characters and louder explosions. GTA 6 continues that tradition for many of its main story beats, chaining showy set-pieces into lethal car chases, but in my 35 hours roaming Leonida I've found plenty of chances to engage with its surprisingly robust stealth system. In some cases, it even feels like Rockstar specifically designed areas with sneaking and silencers in mind.

Illegal operations are lucrative robbery opportunities dotted around the map that hide cash, jewellery, drugs, and unique items – cars, weapons, watches – guarded by armies of enemies. I struggled with them early on: shooting my way to the valuables attracted GTA 6's menacing police, curtailing my heists before I could grab all the loot and forcing me to flee across entire counties while a chopper buzzed overhead.

Now, I treat these scenarios like stealth vignettes, my goal to remain hidden for as long as possible. I've screwed silencers onto my weapons and prioritized headshot precision over spraying power, carrying a pistol alongside either a tactical rifle or a sniper. My shotgun is purely for backup, just in case.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/26/gta-6-lucia-stealth-blogroll-1795691695958.jpg

Skirting around these hideouts reveals hidden entrances. For Janjak's Garage in Vice City, for example, you can mantle a dumpster in a neighbouring alley to reach the garage's sheet metal roof. Out West, on the edge of Port Gellhorn, you can avoid the main gates of the giant Brooks Boatworks and slip through holes in the fence.

Stealth detection is intuitive. Crouching reduces noise, sightlines feel realistic, and you'll be warned by a yellow arrow over an enemy's head before they fully spot you, allowing you a window to nip back into cover. Knives silently slice enemies' open or you can choke them quietly from behind. And if you need space, you can whistle from cover to draw foes over, or throw bottles to distract them. It's classic stealth game fare.

But I've found that guns with silencers are actually the best option because they avoid the risk of an enemy spinning around at the wrong moment and catching you, knife raised. They mask shots almost completely: I've stood close to enemies and shot at others without being detected. Not everything in GTA 6 adopts Rockstar's general pursuit of realism.

Clusters of enemies are tricky because as soon as you shoot one, the others will spin and look for you. Here, I use focus mode to slow time and pop a series of headshots, plink, plink, plink. Three bodies thud simultaneously. I feel like prime Sam Fisher.

High ground is vital and from the right vantage I can survey the area, plan my route, and pick off enemies from distance. I always clamber to the loftiest point and use the D-pad to tag visible hostiles, which tracks them through walls. In a pinch, focus mode will highlight enemies through walls too, although only if they're nearby.

Some of the level design feels like it's steering you down this silent route. Back at the Boatworks, the first thing I saw after sneaking in was a platform lift to the roof of the main warehouse, high above every enemy. A drop in the ceiling led me to an empty top floor – I've seen this trick repeated in other hideouts, so I always look for ladders or other ways to reach the roof.

In the bigger compounds, staying silent for longer than a few minutes is a real challenge. No matter how many times I ran the Boatworks (I saved before I tried, and reloaded when I failed) I was always eventually spotted by some unaccounted-for enemy. But I reached a point where I could reliably clear the main warehouse floor-by-floor and empty the safe without anyone spotting me. That gave me a headstart on the police when I was eventually found, and by the time officers arrived I'd slipped back out through the fence, goodies jingling in my stash bag.

This feels like the first time stealth has been a core part of a GTA game. During standard stick-ups of stores and jewellers you can find back entrances, kill the alarm and erase security tapes – but you'll always need to confront staff if you want to grab absolutely everything. For that reason, illegal operations feel like the real test of your sneakiness, and I'm relishing each new one that pops up on my map. They have the feel of Far Cry's outposts: flexible, self-contained diversions that I can tick off whenever I need more cash, or just fancy a change of pace.

I've loved all my time with GTA 6 so far, but the best I've felt is when, this morning, I robbed Sound4Sound Studio in north Vice City. After hopping the fence I systematically cleared the parking lot and slipped inside, carving through the building, headshot after headshot. Nobody saw me coming, the police never arrived, and afterwards I could explore unchallenged, helping myself to every last bundle of cash. I drove off in a unique custom car, orange paint glistening, tens of thousands of dollars to the good.
I'd take a whole game of these scenarios. Thankfully, I've still got 30 left.
One final bonus of stealth: silencers are comically long, so now Lucia walks around Vice City carrying a gun taller than she is.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/26/gta-6-lucia-stealth-long-1795691104575.jpg

news.title: GTA6最新销量曝光!一周狂卖5300万份 PS5独占75.7%
news.summary: 据分析机构 Alinea Analytics 的预估数据显示，《GTA 6》在上市仅一周后，其全球销量已达到惊人的5300万份。

content.v: 据分析机构 Alinea Analytics 的预估数据显示，《GTA 6》在上市仅一周后，其全球销量已达到惊人的5300万份。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/27/small_202611272247033124.jpg
知名分析师Rhys Elliott在社交平台分享了这一数据，并指出PS5平台在此次首发热潮中占据了绝对主导地位。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/27/small_202611272246431157.jpg
在5300万份的总销量中，PS5平台贡献了75.7%的份额。总营收方面，《GTA 6》在一周内狂揽约47亿美元。由于各地区定价策略的差异，PS5平台的收入占比进一步攀升至76.1%。此外，数据显示美国市场是PS5版的重要票仓，占据了该平台销量的33.5%。
除了惊人的销量，玩家的游玩时长数据同样引人瞩目。据统计，目前已有高达700万名玩家在游戏中的游玩时间超过了50个小时；更有近25万名硬核玩家，游玩时长已经突破了100个小时大关。这对于一款刚发售一周的游戏来说，足见其内容体量与黏性。
关于本作更详尽的深度数据分析报告，将于之后发布。
需要指出的是，上述数据均来源于第三方分析机构的估算，并非Rockstar或Take-Two官方公布的最终财报数据，具体精确销量与营收情况仍以官方后续披露为准。

news.title: 在 GTA 6 中失去六颗星是不可能的，但玩家们正在尝试一切，从跨维度传送门到隐藏掩体
news.summary: Losing six stars in GTA 6 is meant to be impossible, but players are trying everything from interdimensional p

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/27/gtavi-37-1795788130773.jpg

GTA 6 's new police system is one of the most interesting things about the game. Instead of omnipresent cops, the police have have various levels of awareness, and you can use guile and cunning to outsmart them and escape.

There are still wanted stars, which represent how much of the police force is dedicated to hunting you down, but a well-considered escape plan can get you out of most kinds of trouble. Just escape the search zone, lose line of sight, and change how you look to get away.

That is unless you cause too much carnage. If you go off the deep end and cause real mayhem, you’ll eventually reach six stars. Six stars in GTA 6 sees almost the entire map become a search zone, and the cops will never stop tracking you down, according to Rockstar. If you need a pointer, here's how to get a six-star wanted level in GTA 6 .

If you hide indoors, the army comes along with a tank. If you jump in a plane, jets are scrambled to shoot you down. If you try to escape by car, attack helicopters perform a strafing run to blow you off the road. Eventually, no matter how hard you try, you will succumb to the pressure. Six stars, it is thought, amounts to a death sentence.

But is that guaranteed? Since GTA 6 came out, players have been looking for creative ways of breaking the rule around the highest wanted level. Using clever tricks, some are exploring ways to escape a six-star police hunt and return to regular gameplay — which should technically only be possible two ways: you die or get busted.
Warning! GTA 6 spoilers follow.
How to lose six-star wanted level in GTA 6
One player used a series of secret bunkers that you can open up to get access to a GTA 6 tank . Here’s the clip:
⭐️ LE PREMIER JOUEUR AU MONDE A RÉUSSIR À SEMER LES 6 ETOILES SUR GTA 6 ! Il est allé dans un sous sol rempli de bunkers pour réussir à semer la police. https://t.co/8Q0nd27eOn

Another player in the comments said they managed to replicate this by swimming. “Bro, I actually did it yesterday. I managed to escape the 6-star wanted level,” they said . “Just keep diving underwater, and when your oxygen is almost depleted, swim back to the surface. Keep repeating this until you find a jet ski. Then ride it beyond the 6-star search area, and boom! You're free.”

Some players think the underwater cave system in Emerald Springs could be another prime candidate, since cops can’t send diving teams after you. If you head to Emerald Spring and look for signs for the Selkie Hole, there’s diving equipment you can use to explore an underground cave network.

Another player went to more extreme lengths to avoid the cops. After completing the majority of the long Vice City Easter egg in GTA 6 , they left the world through a portal back to the ‘80s. When they came back to present-day Leonida, the cops didn’t care about them or their Tommy Vercetti shirt anymore. Here’s that clip:
世界初？GTA6で手配度6から逃げきることに成功しました https://t.co/0g7pSPJ6UU

“The cops in GTA are so overpowered that you can't escape them unless you go to another world,” said one commenter . “Now THAT'S how you escape the six star wanted level. That’s gangsta,” said another .

One fan also claimed to have escaped six stars by swimming into an underwater research station. Unfortunately, the video doesn’t actually show the six stars vanishing, but I guess they technically escaped, as long as they stay there forever.
6 STARS ESCAPE Underwater Research Facility IN GTA 6 (is coded if you get 6 stars they will recognize you no matter what, testes same thing with 5 stars and it worked) https://t.co/jfZZMzdvs4

It’ll be interesting to see if any new strategies formulate around losing six stars, although getting the full six isn’t something that generally happens by accident in ordinary gameplay. You have to cause a lot of carnage to bring the full weight of Leonida’s police down on your head.

We’ve got the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide here on IGN, complete with comprehensive walkthroughs up to Chapter 5 , guides for the Optional Missions and Illegal Operations you’ll find in Leonida, and much more. Just getting started in Chapter 1 ? Check out our Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , and make a note of the Best Free Weapons to Find Early . 要知道，乔布斯有黑色高领衫，扎克伯格有灰色T恤，而黄仁勋的符号就是那件皮衣，如今想让他换掉，难度可想而知。
据了解，这封落款11月18日的信由PETA总裁Tracy Reiman发出，信中一边肯定黄仁勋是科技创新者，一边直言他的穿衣品味早就过时了。
原话颇有话术水准：技术不会抱着过时的系统前进，时尚也一样。PETA呼吁所有人转向仙人掌、软木、苹果等植物材料制成的素食皮革，把动物制品从衣柜里清除出去。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/27/small_202611272147016224.png
为了让黄仁勋无痛过渡，组织寄去的是Benedetti Life品牌的夹克，采用Oleatex面料，一种用橄榄采收废料制成的人造皮革，内衬为有机棉，外层95%是Biotex材料加5%聚氨酯。
PETA还附赠了一个处置方案：建议黄仁勋把旧皮衣捐给他们筹办中的动物源暴行博物馆，并承诺捐献者可获得税收抵扣。
不过老黄的回应方式相当黄仁勋，11月23日他回到英伟达总部时确实换了造型，但身上穿的既不是旧皮衣，也不是PETA寄来的橄榄皮衣，而是GQ辨认出的一件3300美元（约合21958元人民币）的迪奥棉质夹克。
结合他此前自称拥有30到40件皮衣的说法，想让这位创始人放弃自己的制服，恐怕不是一封信和一件样品能解决的。

news.summary: 近日，《堕落之主》官方发布了最新的2.5.338版本更新公告。本次更新重点围绕中文本地化质量、近距离PvP战斗体验、反作弊系统以及游…

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/27/small_202611272128374491.png
近日，《堕落之主》官方发布了最新的2.5.338版本更新公告。本次更新重点围绕中文本地化质量、近距离PvP战斗体验、反作弊系统以及游戏稳定性进行了全面优化与修复。
根据官方公布的更新内容，本次版本更新的核心亮点包括以下几个方面：
全面优化中文文本
针对国内玩家关心的本地化问题，官方对游戏内的简体中文和繁体中文文本进行了全面校对，修正并润色了多处译文，旨在提供更准确、流畅的文本阅读体验。
强化反作弊与PvP体验
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/27/small_202611272128454760.jpg
为维护多人游戏的公平性，本次更新新增了反作弊措施和封禁工具。同时，针对近距离PvP交战，官方优化了镜头表现，使玩家在激烈对抗时的战斗视角更加稳定。
修复崩溃问题
开发团队修复了游戏中的多处崩溃问题，进一步提升了游戏整体的运行稳定性。
此外，官方在公告中呼吁，如果玩家怀疑有其他人作弊，可将该玩家的用户名或ID以及相关证据发送至官方邮箱（support@cigames.com）进行举报。
在公告末尾，CI Games团队以游戏经典的问候语向广大玩家致意：“行无所惧，心向光明。各位持灯者，祝游戏愉快！”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/27/small_202611272128107512.png
另外值得一提的是，官方此前确认，续作《堕落之主2》不仅配备简体中文文本，还会加入完整中文配音，方便国内玩家更沉浸地体验这片黑暗奇幻世界。

content.v: 由日本独立游戏团队C-Chicken制作的《只管拔草》（暂译，原名 只管拔草）从今天起在Steam平台推出。玩家的目标是清理一块长满杂草的场地。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261127/1795767732_170178_jpg_r.jpg
《只管拔草》是一款劳动模拟游戏，目标是拔掉10万株杂草。你可以一个人默默拔草，也可以最多6人一起边聊边拔。只管专心拔草吧。把拔下来的草喂给山羊换钱，再拿钱去买全新的除草工具。
拔草、卖草、升级，再拔草
一开始只能空手一根根拔。你可以把收集来的杂草喂给山羊店员换钱，再用赚来的钱买更好的工具。工具越好，拔草就越快，也越容易攒够下次升级要花的钱。
铲子只是起点
空手 → 铲子 → 拔草机 → 黑洞 → UFO，光靠园艺工具可拔不完。铲子一次能拔起更多草，到了后期，黑洞和UFO也会加入。每升一次级，就能更快清理下一片杂草。
下一根草会长什么样？
有些草长得和普通杂草不一样。场地里藏着一些形状古怪的草，你在赚钱升级的过程中也能遇到小惊喜。
最多6人，拔光10万根草
你可以自己安静地拔，也可以找最多5位好友联机。大家边聊天边分工，一起试试新工具，朝着清空场地的目标努力。

content.v: 游戏开发商兼发行商网石集团（Netmarble Corporation）宣布，旗下大型吸血鬼风格MMORPG《VAMPIR：血之继承者》的首个钻石狂潮服务器「ONE」即日起开放事前预约，并将于12月9日正式开放。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261127/1795765485_297958_jpg_r.jpg
全新服务器将于12月9日开放，提供为期12周的超高速成长支援、超过1万次召唤机会及专属排名奖励。
【以下内容为厂商提供的资料原文】
「ONE」预计于12月9日下午5点正式开放。这是一个以角色成长为核心的全新服务器，所有玩家都可以站在同一起跑线上重新展开冒险。服务器将在这12周内提供丰富的成长支援与特别奖励，帮助玩家更快提升角色实力。
即日起至12月9日下午1点59分，玩家可通过《VAMPIR：血之继承者》官方网站进行事前预约。所有参与事前预约的玩家都可获得「VAMPIR ONE支援箱」，内含英雄形态指定召唤券、英雄装备全套箱，以及仅能通过事前预约获得的专属「不灭者普兰兹」肖像。服务器开放后，玩家还可通过完成指定的等级达成任务，额外获得14项英雄级奖励。
在12周内，「ONE」将提供丰富的奖励，帮助玩家快速提升角色实力。玩家只需登录游戏，即可获得可进行超过1万次召唤的召唤券。每周排名奖励则包括服务器专属货币「ONE钻石」。此外，玩家还可通过为期8周的任务获得共计8万枚「ONE钻石」，平时游玩就能积累相当可观的服务器专属货币。
同时，玩家在形态、坐骑、技能卡片、棺材、地面眷属及漂浮眷属这6个类别中，首次获得任一类别的传说级道具时，可额外获得一张同类别的传说召唤券。每个类别均可获得这项奖励，玩家可以随着游戏进度陆续获得额外的传说召唤券。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261127/1795765486_545649.jpg
其他成长奖励包括通过等级达成任务与成长任务可获得的共计2亿金币、英雄级成长道具及装备复原券。以往涉及跨服务器竞争的主要狩猎场，也将改为仅限「ONE」服务器内的玩家相互竞争，为玩家在成长初期提供更友好的环境。
玩家还可在这12周内角逐等级和战斗力排名，争取顶级奖励。战斗力排名第一的玩家将获得神话形态召唤券，等级排名第一的玩家则将获得神话坐骑召唤券。其他排名前列的玩家也可获得传说形态与坐骑召唤券。
为期12周的活动结束后，「ONE」服务器的玩家可选择任意一个现有服务器转移角色，保留原有的成长进度，并进入游戏中更广泛的竞争环境。服务器运营及转移时间安排的详细信息将另行公布。
《VAMPIR：血之继承者》由曾打造《我独自升级：ARISE》《天堂2：革命》《二之国：交错世界》等人气作品的Netmarble Neo负责开发。该作汇集了曾为《天堂2：革命》和《二之国：交错世界》的成功发挥主导作用的核心开发成员，并通过完整的跨平台支持，致力于带来全新且具有突破性的MMORPG体验。
《VAMPIR：血之继承者》将带领玩家进入一个非典型的叙事世界。故事的核心并非英雄主义，而是围绕死亡与复仇的情感展开。《VAMPIR：血之继承者》采用电影级的表现手法、强烈而富有魅惑感的吸血鬼视觉风格，以及大胆的游戏设计架构，其中包括将以成长为导向的内容与竞争环境分开。游戏由此突破传统框架，重新定义MMORPG体验。
如需了解更多信息，请访问《VAMPIR：血之继承者》官方网站，并关注官方YouTube和Facebook账号。

content.v: I am an absolute sucker for physical media—my bookshelves are adorned with generations of console games, I have a CD stash tucked away in my Mum's attic, and I still refuse to buy a Kindle in favour of good ol' fashioned paper and ink. And as we increasingly veer into a more digital age, I've noticed a huge uptick in people yearning to bring their hobbies and collections back into a more tangible form.

Music, especially, has seen a huge resurgence in physical popularity. Y'all, my best friend is buying CDs and ripping them onto his PC. Like the good old days! And we've also seen an increasing number of videogame soundtracks make their way onto CD and vinyl, which is something that I am a huge fan of. I love music. I love videogames. I love things I can hold in my hands. It's a triple win!

Unfortunately, this Black Friday hasn't brought about a ton of good deals on videogame vinyl. But that doesn't mean there aren't little offers to be found here and there. So if you're fixing to expand your physical media collection—or seeking out a gift for the videogame music lover in your life—I've got you covered.

news.title: 旧的不去，新的不来｜机事本11.21-11.27
news.summary: 【机事本】是机核文章区的栏目，每周五更新。每周五下班之前，我们会收集几位编辑的“小作文”，题材随意，立意自选，栏目名取自Windows系统自带的最轻便的文本编辑器，代表“轻便与畅快”。 本周出场人物：白广大，柏亚舟，Je

content.v: 【机事本】是机核文章区的栏目，每周五更新。每周五下班之前，我们会收集几位编辑的“小作文”，题材随意，立意自选，栏目名取自Windows系统自带的最轻便的文本编辑器，代表“轻便与畅快”。
本周出场人物：白广大，柏亚舟，Jerry
白广大：旧的不去，新的不来
就在刚才，冯骥发了一篇个人公众号长文，《后 AI 时代最重要的问题》，还在结尾贴心地写了首冯骥作词、SunoAI作曲、编曲、演唱的歌曲《我不得不把才华埋葬在昨天》。
我觉得就是《钟馗》进度不够导致他没有机会写歌才为这碟醋包了篇8000字饺子。
不过，我觉得这篇文章里说的事确实是对的。“最庞大的IP神作在刷新商业上限，最古老的数学圣杯在松动，最先进的创作工具在把专业门槛狠狠拆除。”
https://image.gcores.com/d76c3172362657dc67da91374b2041f1-845-478.png
https://image.gcores.com/c51ec21e1f505d9b4d22d4746846969f-1020-673.png
https://image.gcores.com/4cdf6a71176109192da357944dd47a54-1024-492.png
以及，在目前最为如火如荼的游戏是下面这个，全球顶尖的年轻玩家们正在AI的超级加持下，疯狂进行速通竞技：
https://image.gcores.com/a686a72b22c0ad0f06432005a4012e1b-1280-468.png
这就回到了卡总在文章里提出的问题：
“如果有一天没有任何工作需要人了，人该怎么办？”
我觉得这是一个从旧时代过渡到新时代的，已经在人类历史上出现过几次的问题。在此之前，为了处理资源与需求之间的不平等——主要是因生产力不足而导致的资源供给不足——人类社会想过了很多法子。但现在，当一个Agent可以用两小时搓出形神兼备的一个游戏时，这个问题就落回到了人类自身。
蒸汽机与内燃机攻占了体力劳动领域，而在当下，算力正在攻占脑力原有的神圣的高地。但文明会因此失去原有的光辉吗？
同样的事件并不是没有在历史上发生过。印刷机、电话与互联网带来了信息传播的一个又一个新时代，人们在那些时候，同样都在渴求着最新的信息。而今，生产信息也不再是有限、珍贵、沉重的资源了，它可以被量产了。
但之后我们要做什么呢？人不需要工作的时候，会去做什么呢？
如果没有任何工作需要人了，人就不需要劳动吗？
我的答案是需要。
人会追求自我实现，会去做无意义但证明自己与现实相连的事，去回归自己所钟情的存在与价值。劳动是人类改造自然、获取食物与生活资料的基本方式，也是社会运转和财富创造的根基。如果食物与生活资料都随着物质与精神资源供给的丰富而不再成为制约生存的关键因素，人类也仍然需要劳动。
会做游戏，做自己喜欢的事，从自然中获得反馈，或从人群中获得反馈。
人就是这样的啊。
做自己真正喜欢的事，找到自己真正喜欢的东西，在之后将无比重要。
每个人的自由发展是一切人的自由发展的条件。我想，后AI时代真正的自由，既包含不需为一日三餐终生辛苦劳作的自由，也包含着不必向其他人证明自己“有用”的自由。
就像我们之前在节目里说的那样，现在开始，做一个属于自己的、无用但有趣的游戏吧。
当游戏创造的生产力被技术解放出来之后，玩家们不但善于破坏一个旧世界，还将善于建设一个新世界。
柏亚舟：夺冠即解散是最好的归宿吗？
如题。这个话题感觉还挺有趣的。
话题的引发自然是BLG——一支夺冠后已经注定不能“原班人马再来一年”的队伍，当然说“解散”有点夸张：我们的下路选手朴到贤（Viper）选择回国，比较显性的原因是照顾生病的母亲，冠军班底注定无法维系，BLG也在已经在寻找新的下路。
https://image.gcores.com/469a1be4422935e1608f183ae6fac884-2000-1125.jpg
这个话题的张力在于，如果认为答案是肯定的，自然是因为，对这个班底而言，巅峰五人组的赛场最后时刻就留在了夺冠的瞬间，不会出现下滑，不会出现可能的分崩离析，不会有背叛、不会有决裂，一切都会在回忆的巅峰时刻凝固。
用一句流行的话讲，这个组合再也不会输了。
我尝试类比足球，这种情况其实也很少，毕竟足球几乎不会存在“完全的原班人马”，庞大得多的队伍里，如果核心框架还在，就会被视作“原班人马”，夺冠即解散，可能只会存留在一些黑马夺冠的奇迹里，比如十年前的莱斯特，比如前几年的勒沃库森，但这种情况，“过把瘾就死”也算没什么遗憾了。
反过来对我来说，BLG这次的无法挽留，我一定是遗憾的情绪更加浓重。如果不是不可抗力，我是真的希望原班人马继续战斗下去的——可能我略微抖M一些，我觉得一个队伍，在探究自己的上限地过程中，哪怕站过巅峰后续又再次跌倒，哪怕最后惨淡收场甚至鱼死网破，都是属于它叙事的一部分。
毕竟白月光这个东西，不管是回忆的故事本身，还是哪个具体的人，不会因为故事的走向而改变，它就在那里。
https://image.gcores.com/d4bffe5e00be7f08df7d68f61a10ef3c-2000-1333.png
Jerry：全面翻新的老游戏
最近我在玩一款全面翻新的老游戏。
它是一款上线不久就饱受好评的作品；
对很多玩家来说，它二十多年前的原作，是一份来自童年的经典回忆；
而这套由简入繁的玩法，放到今天的市场里，依然一点不过时；
在游戏一开头，我们优先要掌握的，就是锁定目标的能力；
再往后，如果熟练掌握游戏里开放的各种道具，会给冒险提供不少助力；
虽然只能操纵男性角色，但角色之间的互动十分精彩；
游戏的核心目标自始至终都很明确——去寻找那份由黄金色所代表的力量。
而如果非要说还有什么抱怨的话：
就是画面虽然经过了彻底翻新，我却依然它的觉得售价有些高昂。
没错，它就是——
https://image.gcores.com/c792753697990d968ba74cf69ad24959-1260-652.png
《黄金矿工：派对狂欢》

news.title: 事实证明杰森可能在 GTA 6 中与曼迪有过一段历史
news.summary: Mandy is obsessed with Jason in GTA 6, but there's dialogue that suggests they hooked up at least once.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/27/mandymain-1795783965057.jpg
As soon as GTA 6 was in our hands, an early game character quickly became a fan favourite: Mandy.
Warning! Spoilers for GTA 6 follow.
It's not hard to see why. Mandy certainly knows how to make an entrance, as she tries in vain to entice Jason away from Lucia . But alas, it is not meant to be.

Fans then did a little digging and found out that Mandy is almost definitely hiding a dark secret ; she's probably killed people. That makes her advances towards Jason — like insisting they were supposed to be married — look dangerously delusional. Jason might have dodged a literal bullet.

However, there is some easy-to-miss dialogue in GTA 6 that suggests Mandy wasn't basing her infatuation with Jason on nothing. You can come across this dialogue as soon as you take control of Lucia and find a meditation spot . The meditation sequence will play some audio from the character's past, usually centred around their insecurities.
AAAAAAAAAH https://t.co/4xxj8rHZAR
In one of Lucia's medititation sequences, she recounts a conversation with Jason that she must have had off-screen after they got back in touch.

"Yeah, okay, we hooked up once, but, you know, barely. And it was a long time ago," we can hear Jason say in Lucia's thoughts. "You don't need to worry about her, Lu. Have you seen you? I know how good I got it. I'm not gonna screw that up again."

Of course, Jason doesn't mention Mandy by name here, but the wording makes it pretty clear it's her. Jason mentions not letting Lucia go again, so it would be after their initial breakup. That means the conversation likely happened after she was released from prison, meaning Lucia was living in the same neighbourhood as Mandy — and was aware of how obsessed she was with Jason.

In fact, another easy-to-miss scene does show that Lucia knows about Mandy. At the end of Chapter 1, during the sequence when you're running away from Jason's house as Lucia, you can find Mandy giving a statement to the cops (and, of course, exaggerating how close she was with Jason).
This game really has everything lol
If you come out of hiding, Lucia can finally confront Mandy, saying, "Stay the f**k away from Jason, you crazy b*tch."
Better yet, the encounter gives us another clue that Mandy is a killer, as she tells the police she "wanted to light [Jason's] house on fire so many times."

With all of this in mind, it's no wonder that Jason was eager to stay away from Mandy early on in GTA 6 — it doesn't seem that she understood he wasn't looking for anything long term with her. Luckily for him, it sounds like Lucia is ready to run to his defence.

Mandy went viral pretty much as soon as GTA 6 came out, with countless social media posts discussing the character's motivations. Mandy actress Lexie Shoaibi has spoken out about her "bittersweet" newfound fame , pointing out that people keep trying to impersonate her on social media. Shoaibi has also revealed she spent around 10 days on set playing Mandy, but she also did a few other NPC voices while working with Rockstar.

news.title: 今日施行！电视不得放开机广告 最高罚10万元
news.summary: 快科技11月27日消息，对于不少电视用户来说，打开电视后第一件事不是看节目，而是等广告播完，如今这一问题迎来了明确的监管要求。

content.v: 快科技11月27日消息，对于不少电视用户来说，打开电视后第一件事不是看节目，而是等广告播完，如今这一问题迎来了明确的监管要求。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/27/small_202611272049187038.png
今日，国家广播电视总局发布的《有线广播电视运营服务管理规定》和《交互式网络电视运营服务管理暂行规定》正式施行。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/27/small_202611272049197106.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/27/small_202611272049267312.jpg
两项新规针对开机广告、直播观看、节目收费及遥控操作等方面提出了明确要求。
其中，有线广播电视和交互式网络电视（IPTV）运营服务应当坚持直播优先原则，实现开机看全屏直播功能，设置频道回看入口，不得播放开机广告。
同时，智能电视应支持优先呈现直播频道功能，并提供便捷设置入口，方便用户自行选择开机进入直播或电视交互主页。
值得注意的是，两项新规均明确了相应的处罚措施。
对于违反相关规定的运营服务提供者、酒店等集团用户，县级以上人民政府广播电视主管部门将责令改正，给予警告、通报批评。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/27/small_202611272049371576.png
情节严重的，并处1万元以上10万元以下的罚款。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/27/small_202611272049389800.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/27/small_202611272049384726.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/27/small_202611272049395573.png
除了开机广告，备受用户吐槽的收费栏目繁多、电视操作复杂等问题，也是此次新规的治理重点。
新规要求在首页设立免费专区，重点推荐优质免费内容，精简收费栏目数量，明确标示节目收费信息，规范应用专区运营和订购支付管理。
此外，运营服务方应不断优化终端性能，缩短开机时长，鼓励采用语音遥控、手机遥控、人工智能等新技术提升用户体验。
在遥控器操作方面，新规明确要求简化操作，实现遥控器一键切换直播信源。
据了解，自2023年以来，广电总局联合多部门开展电视“套娃”收费和操作复杂治理，全国已有超过2.84亿有线电视和IPTV用户实现开机看直播、开机无广告，各类收费包压减70%以上。
随着两项新规正式施行，相关治理成果将进一步得到巩固，让看电视这件事回归简单。

content.v: VISUAL ARTS于今天（2026年11月27日）在Steam发售了PC游戏《虚假的爱丽丝：故事重述》。游戏通常售价为3500日元（含税），截至12月11日可按2800日元（含税）的优惠价购买。
本作是由2019年推出的手机游戏《虚假的爱丽丝》改编而成的视觉小说。为了以一种在手游停运后仍能留存的形式呈现原作故事，《虚假的爱丽丝：故事重述》启动了开发，并通过众筹获得总计6400万日元的支持，最终得以发售。
本作以手游版的主线剧情为基础，重新构建了剧本和演出。剧本文字量达60万字以上，由声优阵容全程配音，并收录150张以上的剧情插图，包含差分图。 原创原声带《虚假的爱丽丝：故事重述Original Soundtrack》也随游戏本体一同发售。
除了为游戏本体增色的背景音乐，原声带还收录了片头主题曲《双面女间谍》和片尾主题曲《さよならを綴じて》。 此外，官方数字画集也已开售。游戏本体、原创原声带和数字画集还可通过捆绑包《虚假的爱丽丝：故事重述 数字合集》一同购买。

news.title: 前 Gran Turismo 世界系列赛参赛者帮助调整 GTA 6 汽车物理
news.summary: A former Gran Turismo World Series competitor helped Rockstar tune GTA 6's car physics.

others.title: GTA 6 的汽车物理由 Gran Turismo Pro 进行调整

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/27/vintage-vice-city-pack-vapid-stanier-02-1795782728767.jpg

A lot of people have complained about the Ganado, Jason’s starting car in GTA 6 , for being tricky to drive. The small pickup is a little unwieldy and prone to swinging out at the back end because it’s based on the Ford Ranchero, a rear-wheel drive whip manufactured between 1957–1979 in North America.

While there are no licensed vehicles in GTA 6, cars are recognisable based on real-world counterparts, with small visual changes to make them legally distinct. But the accuracy doesn’t stop at the car model — it also extends to how they drive.

That variety in handling is in part because Rockstar hired Lewis Bentley, a former Gran Turismo World Series competitor, to work on the vehicle physics team. Bentley announced the news in a now-deleted YouTube video.

“We put the auto in the Grand Theft Auto,” he said from the driver’s seat of his Lotus Elise. Bentley is best known for qualifying for the final in the GT Sport World Tour event at the Nürburgring 24 Hours, in 2018.

“Everyone on the physics team’s amazing,” he said in the same video. He claimed to have worked on GTA 6 for around three years in total, and is listed in the game’s credits as a developer in the physics department.

Bentley isn’t the only gearhead who worked on the game, however. Rockstar North has its own in-house racing team , and they’re pretty good on the track — they won a team-based 24h Nürburgring event back in 2022.

You can see this attention to detail in the game, both in vehicle handling models on cars and on the tracks. For the first time in the series, GTA 6 features a closed asphalt circuit called Gellhorn International Raceway, which stitches together a bunch of iconic corners and racing lines from some of the most famous real-world tracks in existence, turning them into the ultimate speedway.

We’ve got the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide here on IGN, complete with comprehensive walkthroughs up to Chapter 5 , guides for the Optional Missions and Illegal Operations you’ll find in Leonida, and much more. Just getting started in Chapter 1 ? Check out our Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , and make a note of the Best Free Weapons to Find Early . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .

news.title: 官方复盘《剑星》开发：太过复杂 数百个缺陷修复
news.summary: Shift Up技术总监李东基分享《剑星》测试与调校过程：团队在发售约两年前开启首轮测试，68名测试人员共发现并推动解决549项问题。

content.v: 在Console Game Developers Conference 2026上，Shift Up技术总监李东基分享了《剑星》的测试与调校过程。他表示，团队在发售约两年前开启首轮测试，68名测试人员随后共发现并推动解决549项问题。
李东基称，用户测试的职责是呈现玩家感到困难或受挫的客观情况，具体怎样调整仍由开发团队决定。首轮测试于2022年3月进行，当时版本包含基础战斗、勒瓦尔地区的中段内容、3名Boss及成长系统雏形。团队希望借此确认玩家会在哪些位置卡关、实际感受到的难度是否符合预期，以及流程是否足够有趣。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/27/cas_auto/small_0_9513989.jpg
死亡惩罚机制是其中一项较大的改动。早期版本中，角色死亡会损失已积累的技能点数。测试者主要反映用于补偿这一惩罚的道具不够便利，团队据此决定直接取消死亡惩罚，而非只调整相关道具。
战斗资源的获取规则也经过重新梳理。玩家认可积攒资源的过程，但不清楚资源具体如何获得。之后，攻击、格挡与招架用于填充贝塔能量条，成功闪避则填充Burst能量条。针对动作RPG经验较少的玩家，游戏还加入带有Action Assist功能的剧情模式，能以视觉提示辅助判断反应时机，难度也可随时调整。
最终Boss的调校同样来自测试反馈。2023年5月的测试中，这场战斗的满意度只有4.85分。团队发现，玩家在此前尝试中消耗的弹药不会在死亡后恢复，导致应对即死招式时缺乏资源。加入战前弹药补给并提高掉落量后，最终测试的满意度升至8.6分。
李东基也提到，勒瓦尔平台区域的移动惯性问题直到2023年5月才被发现，当时彻底重做移动系统风险过高。团队采取了扩大平台、增加落脚点、仅在该区域关闭惯性的处理方式，因此开放区域的操控反馈仍保留了一部分争议。

news.title: SE业绩大涨！多亏了放弃独占、支持Switch 2
news.summary: Square Enix称，减少独占发行、支持Nintendo Switch 2等新硬件平台，以及强化既有作品销售，是近期业绩改善的推动因素。

content.v: Square Enix近日将近期业绩改善归因于多项因素，其中包括减少独占发行、支持Nintendo Switch 2等新硬件平台，以及强化既有作品的销售。
报道援引Square Enix公布的数据称，公司上一财季销售额为356亿日元，营业利润为130亿日元，较上年同期有所增长。公司还提到《王国之心4》与《最终幻想7：Revelation》等产品带来的市场期待。
Square Enix CEO桐生隆司表示，支持包括Nintendo Switch 2在内的新硬件平台，以及加强目录作品销售，也为业绩作出了贡献。扩大平台覆盖范围、减少独占限制，已成为该公司的长期战略方向之一。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/27/cas_auto/small_0_9513945.jpg
报道还称，Square Enix计划在本财年下半年继续推出多款新作与重制作品，包括10月22日发售的《最终幻想：共鸣》、预计12月推出的《勇者斗恶龙怪兽篇4》，以及计划于2027年2月推出的《浪漫沙加3重制版》。
多平台策略能否持续转化为稳定收益，仍取决于后续作品的品质、发行节奏和各平台用户需求。

news.title: 影之刃零从79%到95%好评如潮!首发的差评真不重要?
news.summary: 根据Steam评价数据，《影之刃零》发售初期的整体好评率约为79%。但随着发售时间推移，越来越多玩家真正玩进游戏、完成通关，评价也…

content.v: 根据Steam评价数据，《影之刃零》发售初期的整体好评率约为79%。但随着发售时间推移，越来越多玩家真正玩进游戏、完成通关，评价也开始发生变化。
发售约三周后，游戏整体好评率已经来到95%，从“多半好评”跨进了“好评如潮”的档位。
编辑观点： 从开局不算亮眼到后来口碑逆袭，现在一款游戏首发时的评价，能有效代表它的真实口碑吗？
游戏的战斗手感、地图设计、美术表现、音乐以及游戏整体体量，都获得了不少肯定，当玩家不再只看首发阶段的第一印象，而是有机会体验完整内容后，《影之刃零》的核心体验逐渐得到了更多认可。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611251159163864.png
当然，首发阶段的差评也不是凭空出现的。游戏初期确实有玩家遇到BUG、闪退和着色器渲染慢等技术问题，这些问题会直接影响游玩体验。对一个刚买游戏、打开就遇到故障的玩家来说，给出差评完全可以理解。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611251159444255.png
这恰恰是首发评分值得讨论的地方：它既反映了游戏刚上线时的真实状态，也容易受到初期技术问题、玩家预期和游玩进度的影响。首发评价当然有参考价值，但它未必就是一款游戏的最终判决。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611251202271948.png
尤其对于国产游戏而言，首发评分往往会被放大解读。一个“多半好评”，很容易被拿来当作作品质量不行的结论。但《影之刃零》的口碑变化也说明，随着版本优化和更多玩家完成体验，评价完全可能出现反转。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/25/small_202611251202407649.png
你觉得《影之刃零》的口碑逆袭是否说明首发评分不重要？还是说首发评价依然是判断一款游戏最有价值的参考？评论区聊聊。

news.title: 有人正在将《博德之门 3》中最受欢迎的反派之一变得浪漫起来
news.summary: One of Baldur's Gate 3's main villains, Gortash, could be romanceable soon thanks to this new fan-made mod.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/11/27/gortash-baldurs-gate-3-1795776334118.jpg
Baldur's Gate 3 has no shortage of romances and romantic encounters, but not everyone in Faerûn is up for a smooch.
When developer Larian was still rolling out updates, fans would often ask for more romances to be added, whether it be for Jaheira or Rolan, but it was never meant to be.
One of the most popular requests was actually for one of Baldur's Gate 3's main villains, Gortash. Larian was very much aware of this, and actually addressed these fans in the patch notes in 2024.
"Listen, he’s a complicated guy who’s busy contemplating the minutia of death cult office politics," Larian said at the time. "Babygurl doesn’t have time to kiss."

But now, a fan is stepping up, adding the Gortash romance that so many were asking for. TikTok user Equipouet has shared some clips from the mod, which is still a work in progress. It shows the player character being invited to spend time with Gortash, played by Lucius Malfoy actor Jason Isaacs, after his coronation in Act 3, all with new dialogue and animations.

We're told that we'll be able to make our own choices when we meet Gortash, specifically whether we want to "charm him, keep him guessing, or walk away." So, if you really hate Gortash, you could also use the mod to let him down.

Much more is teased for the mod, like a ball held by Gortash, letters to exchange with him, and "choices with consequences." There will also be changes to how the story plays out if your character is The Dark Urge, since it's in your backstory that you already have a history with Gortash.

The mod is still being worked on, but the author says they will submit it for console release approval once it's done. That process can be lengthy, however, and there's no guarantee that it will pass the approval stage, especially if it's too bulky for console.

In the meantime, Gortash kissers will keep having to use their imagination. Like us would-be Jaheira kissers. There are also plenty of other mods to try out, including a bunch that have Larian's seal of approval and can be installed within the game's own mod manager.
Image credit: Larian.

news.title: 《我的世界》动画剧集传出制作动向！动画制作方招聘世界构建人员
news.summary: 芒果TV的《我的世界》动画剧集公布两年后，负责动画制作的Flying Bark Productions发布了一则招聘公告，为剧集招募擅长搭建游戏世界、设计其中各类元素的专业人员。这是项目公布以来首次出现制作推进的迹象。F

content.v: 芒果TV的《 我的世界 》动画剧集公布两年后，负责动画制作的Flying Bark Productions发布了一则招聘公告，为剧集招募擅长搭建游戏世界、设计其中各类元素的专业人员。这是项目公布以来首次出现制作推进的迹象。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261127/1795771361_909673_jpg_r.jpg
Flying Bark在招聘公告中写道：“我们需要建造者！加入我们，一起制作芒果TV的《我的世界》动画剧集。”公告配图将芒果TV的标志放在了《我的世界》的游戏场景中。芒果TV于2024年5月公布这部剧集，项目将由WildBrain和Mojang合作制作，动画部分由Flying Bark Productions负责。
《我的世界》于2009年首次推出，2011年发布完整版，此后一直是全球最受欢迎的娱乐系列之一，在世界各地的青少年文化中占有一席之地。游戏的成功催生了多款衍生作品，也让这个系列走上了电影银幕和电视荧屏。
目前有关制作进展的新信息仅来自这则招聘公告，芒果TV尚未直接说明项目的状态。剧集各制作阶段可能还没有明确的日程，具体制作时间表、演员阵容和其他项目细节仍不明朗。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261127/1795771369_167440_jpg_r.jpg
剧集的故事也尚不清楚，预计会采用全新的剧情和角色。《我的世界》的开放世界设定为原创故事和冒险情节留下了空间，制作团队也可以用不同方式呈现玩家熟悉的 像素 世界。
与剧集刚公布时相比，芒果TV如今面临更大的竞争压力。2025年上映的《我的世界大电影》在全球拿下9.6亿美元票房，位列当年全球票房第五。芒果TV公布剧集时，外界已经可以预见它会与当时尚未上映的同系列电影形成竞争，如今电影的票房成绩也已明朗。
动画制作通常耗时较长，这部剧集可能离上线还有很长一段时间。即使电影续集《A我的世界Movie: Squared》也取得很大成功，剧集仍有可能赶上合适的档期。届时观众或许仍想看到更多《我的世界》作品，而影院恰好没有同系列电影在映。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

news.summary: 一名《GTA6》玩家上线了PlayMyPS5网站，访客可以免费在浏览器里排队，远程操控网站创建者的PS5，每人每轮最多玩5分钟。访客无需购买游戏或自备主机。《GTA6》于2026年11月19日登陆PS5和Xbox Ser

content.v: 一名《GTA6》玩家上线了PlayMyPS5网站，访客可以免费在浏览器里排队，远程操控网站创建者的PS5，每人每轮最多玩5分钟。访客无需购买游戏或自备主机。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261127/1795769247_782086_jpg_r.jpg
《GTA6》于2026年11月19日登陆PS5和Xbox Series。Rockstar Games目前尚未公布PC版，手头没有主机的电脑玩家只能继续等待。借助PlayMyPS5，他们现在就能在浏览器里逛逛罪恶 都市 。
网站直接从实体PS5串流游戏画面。所有访客进入同一条队列，轮到谁，谁就在浏览器里接管主机。玩家的操作指令会发送到PS5，主机再将画面传回玩家的屏幕。远程操作难免有延迟，慢慢逛街或做剧情任务仍然可行。
排到的玩家有20秒接手主机，游玩时间一到5分钟，控制权就会交给队列里的下一位。如果玩家连续30秒没有操作，本轮会提前结束。玩完一轮后，玩家可以重新排到队尾。
PlayMyPS5支持手柄、键盘和鼠标，也支持手机触屏操作。访客无需下载软件、付费或注册。等待期间，访客可以观看其他玩家在罪恶都市里的行动，也可以在聊天室和其他观众交流。
开发者发现自己的PS5大部分时间都闲着，于是有了搭建这个网站的想法。如今这台主机几乎从不间断地运行，创建者提议让访客接力完成《GTA6》的全部剧情任务。每位玩家一轮只能推进5分钟，整个通关过程也因此成了一场类似Twitch Plays Pokémon的集体实验。
网站人气很高，排队时间已经长达数小时。为了缩短等待，创建者正在筹集993美元购买第二台PS5，届时就能让更多人同时游玩。拥有PS5和《GTA6》的其他玩家也可以接入平台，自愿开放自己的主机，增加可供访客使用的游玩场次。

news.title: 韩国3A动作新游将进入宣发期！或将登陆TGA
news.summary: 传闻称《Project Tal》可能进入新宣发阶段，或在未来数周公开预告，发售时间可能指向2027年下半年；Wemade尚未确认相关安排。

content.v: 据爆料韩国开放世界动作RPG《Project Tal》可能即将进入新的宣发阶段，后续数周内或有新预告公开。文章推测，这一时间点可能与The Game Awards举办日相近，或许是代表游戏将在颁奖典礼上公开新情报。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/new/content/2026/11/27/cas_auto/small_0_9513657.jpg
《Project Tal》首支正式预告于2025年10月公开。文章提到，该预告在YouTube获得超过200万播放量，在Bilibili也获得数百万播放。Wemade此前面向韩国市场发布的资料曾将其描述为采用虚幻5开发的大型开放世界动作RPG，并提及2027年发售。
关于更具体的上线时间，爆料文章称，项目可能安排在2027年下半年推出，时间或更接近秋季。不过，这只是文章援引消息人士后的说法，Wemade尚未公布正式发售日期、平台信息或下一支预告的发布时间。
文章还提到Wemade投资的Studio Rasa。该工作室据称由曾参与Neowiz、《匹诺曹的谎言》和《剑星》相关项目的开发者组成，正在制作另一款写实风格的AAA动作RPG。该项目传闻中的营销时间和2028年发售目标，同样都没有获得官方确认。

news.title: 内存短缺抬高PC游戏入门成本！外媒仍因旧作兼容和模组选择PC
news.summary: 内存持续短缺推高了PC游戏的入门成本。Tech4Gamers的文章指出，PC市场在内存短缺和涨价前原本明显向好，但过去几年，部分游戏发售时优化不佳，加上价格上涨，已经削弱了PC游戏的吸引力。到了2026年，价格让PC与主

content.v: 内存持续短缺推高了PC游戏的入门成本。Tech4Gamers的文章指出，PC市场在内存短缺和涨价前原本明显向好，但过去几年，部分游戏发售时优化不佳，加上价格上涨，已经削弱了PC游戏的吸引力。到了2026年，价格让PC与主机之间的取舍变得更复杂，但庞大的游戏库和高度自由的自定义选项，仍是PC在价格合适时值得考虑的理由。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260918/1789694077_371668_jpg_r.jpg
PC与主机的主要差别在于玩家有更多选择。从模组、向下兼容到模拟器，PC玩家有多种方式游玩和调整游戏。使用PS5或Xbox Series X时，玩家的商店选择受主机厂商限制。大多数PC玩家满足于使用Steam，但也可以选择Epic Games Store等其他商店。
PC上还有Eneba这样的第三方激活码转售平台，以及GOG这样的游戏商店。专门用于交易的网站也有不少，主要涉及《反恐精英2》等游戏的外观道具和皮肤。其中不少网站支持加密货币付款，经常购买XRP或其他加密货币的用户可以通过自己的钱包完成交易。文章作者认为，PC游戏在涉及欺诈或盗窃的风险上有可能比主机游戏更安全。
游戏库的规模和多样性也是PC的优势。最新一代主机的原生向下兼容通常只覆盖一两代，而PC上既有老游戏，也有近年的热门作品。以颇受玩家喜爱的《合金装备崛起：复仇》为例，在三大主机平台中，只有Xbox Series S和Xbox Series X可以游玩这款作品，而PC版从游戏首发时就已推出。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261127/1795769221_186047_jpg_r.jpg
动视发行的《蜘蛛侠：暗影之网》和《蜘蛛侠：破碎维度》也能在PC上游玩，最新一代主机则无法运行这两款游戏。由于这些主机的向下兼容范围有限，还有一批老游戏如今只能在PC上找到。模拟器进一步扩大了选择，让PC玩家也能玩到从未在该平台发售的作品。
借助AI进行逆向工程和重新编译的玩家项目，最近也开始受到关注。AI技术的进展让多款作品得以在PC上重新推出，其中不少还带有改进。《铁拳6》近期就通过借助AI的逆向工程推出了PC版本，并增强了在线游玩功能，受到《铁拳》玩家社群欢迎。这类玩家项目在PC上早已存在，AI能力的发展降低了参与门槛。
《忍者龙剑传 黑之章》和《超级马力欧64》也已通过重新编译实现了在PC上原生运行。还有玩家一度让《给他爱5》在浏览器里运行，但该项目随后被Rockstar Games下架。Tech4Gamers的文章作者认为，尽管PC游戏在价格方面比以往任何时候都更不利，以他目前的游戏需求，仍会选择PC。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

news.title: 《GTA6》通关后玩家吐槽太无聊 钱没地方花、内容少
news.summary: 近日，部分玩家对《GTA6》通关后的内容量表示不满，相关讨论在玩家社区引发热议。

content.v: 由你来说： 《GTA6》通关后有玩家认为存在玩法不足的问题吗？买不了房、不能经营生意，赚钱也缺少动力，你觉得这些吐槽你觉得在理吗？
近日，部分玩家对《GTA6》通关后的内容量表示不满，相关讨论在玩家社区引发热议。
有玩家指出，《GTA6》目前缺少不少值得长期体验的玩法。例如，除了车库之外，玩家无法购买其他房产，也不能经营自己的生意，赚钱的动力因此大幅降低，毕竟游戏中几乎没有太多地方可以花钱。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/27/small_202611271912147999.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/11/27/small_202611271912157631.png
更让部分玩家感到不满的是，如果长时间独自在开放世界中探索，还可能导致玩家与露西亚之间的关系恶化。
针对这些内容缺失，玩家猜测，房产购买、商业经营以及股市交易等系统可能会被留到《GTA Online》中推出。
与此同时，越来越多玩家开始期待《GTA6》能够推出完整的单人剧情扩展内容，希望R星能像《GTA4》那样，为游戏带来独立剧情DLC。
